cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — chest-deep in the water; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a starship data archive — standing; A bright public weather exhibit with a shallow demonstration channel and sunlit glass ceiling — Dressed for the exhibit as an imaginary current reader; A nearly empty civic tram car crossing broad salt flats under a gray-white sky — She spends a rare unhurried commute watching a line of bright mineral pools pass the window while peeling one small orange; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — fans a folding fan open between her hands; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake at chest height; her bedroom — perched on a ledge or edge; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her front; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — carries her keepsake low at her side
